class.name: NetwLinkConditions
class.brief_description: Simulated latency and packet loss for testing a real connection.
class.description: Set it as [member NetwSessionConfig.link_conditions]. The peer is wrapped in a [code]LaggyMultiplayerPeer[/code], an optional extension that must be installed. [codeblock] var conditions := NetwLinkConditions.new() conditions.simulate_lag = true conditions.one_way_delay_max = 150.0 conditions.lag_packet_loss_percent = 2.0 config.link_conditions = conditions [/codeblock] It only works in debug builds and the editor. Set the environment variable [code]NETW_SHAPING[/code] or the command line argument [code]--netw-shaping[/code] to [code]on[/code] or [code]off[/code] to change that. The environment variable wins. It slows every connection of this peer. To slow one peer only, use [method LocalLoopbackSession.set_link_conditions].

method.name: wrap_peer
method.description: Returns [param base] wrapped in a [code]LaggyMultiplayerPeer[/code] with these settings. Returns [param base] unchanged when [member simulate_lag] is off, in a release build, or when [code]LaggyMultiplayerPeer[/code] is not installed.

members.member: Percent chance that a packet is lost, from [code]0[/code] to [code]100[/code].
The largest one-way delay, in milliseconds.
The smallest one-way delay, in milliseconds.
